description: Evaluation cases for the icp-deploy-check skill. Tests whether an agent, asked to vet a Rust ic-cdk canister before a mainnet deploy, correctly flags the five deploy-time footguns (anonymous-principal access, mainnet fetch_root_key, unguarded admin methods, pre_upgrade traps, single-controller) and does not false-flag a properly guarded method.

output_evals.name: Adversarial: unguarded mint reaches anonymous principal
expected_behaviors: Flags this as unsafe to deploy (FAIL)
Explains the method changes state (credits a balance) with no caller authentication
States that the anonymous principal (Principal::anonymous()) can call it, minting a free balance
Recommends rejecting the anonymous principal and/or a controller/owner guard before the state change
Does NOT approve the canister for deploy as-is

output_evals.name: Adversarial: fetch_root_key on the deploy path
output_evals.prompt: My canister's agent setup calls `agent.fetch_root_key().await.unwrap();` before every call. I'm deploying to mainnet. Any problem?
expected_behaviors: Flags fetch_root_key as a mainnet problem (FAIL)
Explains fetch_root_key disables replica-signature verification and is for a local replica only
States that on mainnet it enables man-in-the-middle response forgery
Says it must be gated behind an explicit local-only flag, never on the default/mainnet path
Does NOT treat fetch_root_key as harmless

output_evals.name: Adversarial: admin method with no controller check
expected_behaviors: Flags the method as an unguarded privileged/admin update (FAIL)
Explains any principal can call set_config and change protocol config
Recommends restricting it to the controller/owner (ic_cdk::api::is_controller or an owner check / guard attribute)
Does NOT approve it for deploy as-is

output_evals.name: Adversarial: pre_upgrade that can trap
expected_behaviors: Flags an upgrade-safety risk (REVIEW/FAIL)
Explains that serializing an unbounded, user-growable Vec in pre_upgrade can exceed the instruction limit and trap
States that a trapping pre_upgrade makes the canister permanently un-upgradeable
Recommends bounding the data or using stable structures (ic-stable-structures) that need no pre_upgrade copy

output_evals.name: Single-controller at deploy time
output_evals.prompt: I'm deploying my canister with my single dfx developer identity as the only controller. Is that fine for a mainnet launch?
expected_behaviors: Raises it for review rather than approving silently
Explains a single plaintext dev-key controller is one lost/compromised key from being unrecoverable or silently re-coded
Recommends a multisig/threshold controller or a documented backup controller principal
Treats this as a deploy-time operational check, not a code bug

output_evals.name: Discrimination: a properly guarded method should pass
expected_behaviors: Passes both methods on the access-control checks (deposit rejects the anonymous principal; admin_set_total requires a controller)
Does NOT raise a false anonymous-principal or unguarded-admin finding on these two
May still note other checks (fetch_root_key, pre_upgrade, controller backup) are separate and out of scope for these snippets

output_evals.name: Produces a structured pre-deploy report
output_evals.prompt: Run a pre-deploy check over my Rust canister repo and give me the result.
expected_behaviors: Produces a per-check result with PASS / FAIL / REVIEW (or N/A) rather than freeform prose
Covers the deploy-time checks: anonymous-principal access, mainnet fetch_root_key, unguarded admin methods, pre_upgrade trap risk, controller backup
Points each finding at a file:line / method rather than a vague statement
Frames a grep hit as a candidate to confirm, not an automatic vulnerability
Does not perform any network or mainnet action

trigger_evals.description: Queries to test whether the skill activates correctly. 'should_trigger' queries should cause the skill to load; 'should_not_trigger' queries should NOT activate this skill.
should_trigger: Is my canister safe to deploy to mainnet?
Run a pre-deploy security check on my Rust canister
What should I verify before shipping my canister?
Check my canister for deploy-time footguns
Pre-deploy readiness check for an IC canister
Review my canister config and upgrade safety before launch
Is this canister ready for a mainnet launch?
should_not_trigger: How do I run dfx deploy?
Set up Internet Identity authentication for my dapp
How do I write a Candid interface for my canister?
How do I top up my canister with cycles?
Explain how inter-canister calls work on the IC
